```sql
WITH bihar_districts AS (
  SELECT
    "District",
    NULLIF("Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)"::DOUBLE, 0) AS immunisation_4,
    NULLIF("Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)"::DOUBLE, 0) AS immunisation_5
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE "State" = 'Bihar'
    AND "District" IN ('Bhojpur', 'Gaya', 'Madhubani', 'Nalanda', 'Purnia', 'Rohtas', 'Saran')
    AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
),
bihar_districts_5 AS (
  SELECT
    "District",
    NULLIF("Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)"::DOUBLE, 0) AS immunisation_5
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE "State" = 'Bihar'
    AND "District" IN ('Bhojpur', 'Gaya', 'Madhubani', 'Nalanda', 'Purnia', 'Rohtas', 'Saran')
    AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
)
SELECT
  bd."District",
  (immunisation_5 - immunisation_4) AS points_change
FROM bihar_districts bd
JOIN bihar_districts_5 bd5 ON bd."District" = bd5."District"
```
